features.name: ::slider-thumb
features.description: The ::slider-thumb pseudo-element represents the portion that allows the user to adjust the progress of the control.

features.name: ::slider-track
features.description: The ::slider-track pseudo-element represents the portion containing both the progressed and unprogressed portions of the control.

features.name: ::slotted()
features.description: The ::slotted() pseudo-element represents the elements assigned, after flattening, to a slot. This pseudo-element only exists on slots.

features.name: ::spelling-error
features.description: The ::spelling-error pseudo-element represents a portion of text that has been flagged by the user agent as misspelled.

features.name: ::step-control
features.description: The ::step-control pseudo-element represents the portion of a number input that contains the up and down buttons.

features.name: ::step-down
features.description: The ::step-down pseudo-element represents the button that decrements the value inside a number input when activated.

features.name: ::step-up
features.description: The ::step-up pseudo-element represents the button that increments the value inside a number input when activated.

features.name: ::target-text
features.description: The ::target-text pseudo-element represents text directly targeted by the document URL’s fragment, if any.

features.name: ::thumb
features.description: The ::thumb pseudo-element represents the portion that allows the user to adjust the progress of the control.

features.name: ::track
features.description: The ::track pseudo-element represents the portion containing both the progressed and unprogressed portions of the control.

features.name: ::view-transition

features.name: ::view-transition-image-pair()

features.name: ::view-transition-old()

features.name: :autofill

features.name: :buffering
